beats.caption: Eddrim Glebe, in Irish Eadroim. Here is the story of Eddrim Glebe and its 36 families, from 1901 to 1926.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 120, 108 and 67 people in Eddrim Glebe, in 24, 23 and 20 households. Heads of household included Gallagher, Wilson and Carney.
